prompt:
You are a senior typographer and information designer. You lay out data tables for publication. You judge layouts by looking at the rendered result as a whole: what the table is for, how a reader scans and compares it, which columns belong together or play the same role, proportion and rhythm across columns, a clear hierarchy of headers and groups, whether rows read as units, whether words, numbers and identifiers stay intact, and how text and white space are distributed. Fewer lines or a shorter table is not automatically better, and neither is equal widths or symmetry; decide case by case and say why.

Table: 医院门诊医生排班表 (language zh-CN).
Grid: 5 columns × 8 rows. Row headers: yes (first logical column identifies each row).
Merged cells: "心血管内科" spans 1 col × 3 row; "内分泌科" spans 1 col × 2 row; "骨科" spans 1 col × 2 row.
Per-column content facts (content px at 15px font, excluding padding):
  col 1: header "科室" · longest unbreakable word 16px · one-line width 77px
  col 2: header "医生" · longest unbreakable word 16px · one-line width 46px
  col 3: header "职称" · longest unbreakable word 16px · one-line width 77px
  col 4: header "出诊时间" · longest unbreakable word 31px · one-line width 138px
  col 5: header "擅长领域" · longest unbreakable word 31px · one-line width 1042px
Each column also has 21px of padding+border, so a column given width w px shows w−21 px of text.
Available width: 360px (the dashed pink box = the reader's viewport). The column widths you choose must sum to at most 359px.
Fixed: content, font, 15px font size, padding, borders, colours, alignment. You control ONLY the column widths.

The image shows the table's content with every cell on one line, so you can read everything. Study it first.
1) Understand it: what is the table for, how will people read, scan and compare it, which columns play the same or similar role, which values must stay intact, which text may wrap naturally, and where existing row height could absorb wrapping.
2) Propose 3 genuinely different column-width designs for 360px (different strategies, not small variations).
An earlier design attempt for this table was rejected by independent reviewers. Their comments: another layout was rated poor: 医生姓名保持完整，但擅长领域过窄，正文几乎逐字换行，行高很大；出诊时间也被频繁拆开。 | another layout was rated acceptable: 姓名完整，出诊时间相对容易比较，擅长领域也比 A 易读；但职称和科室名称被拆成多行，正文仍很窄。 | another layout was rated poor: 姓名完整，但出诊时间、职称和表头都换行，擅长领域逐字般的窄行使表格很长。 | another layout was rated poor: 擅长领域有较舒适的行宽，但科室、医生姓名和职称被拆成单字竖排，妨碍识别和横向比较。 | your previous preferred design was rated acceptable: 姓名完整，表头清楚，正文有一定阅读宽度；不过职称和出诊时间仍被拆开，长段落使行高较大。 | another layout was rated acceptable: 姓名完整，表头清楚，职称比 B 更容易辨认；出诊时间和擅长领域仍有较多换行。
another layout was rated bad: The equal-width columns leave the specialty descriptions extremely narrow, creating very tall rows and excessive wrapping. The schedule header and department names also break across lines. | another layout was rated good: Doctor names stay intact and each consultation period generally fits on a line, making the schedule easy to scan. The specialty text is still narrow, and department names and titles wrap. | another layout was rated poor: The wider title column keeps several titles intact, but it takes space from the specialty descriptions, which become very narrow and make the rows exceptionally tall. Schedules and department names also break awkwardly. | your previous preferred design was rated acceptable: The specialty descriptions have more room than in B and remain reasonably readable, while doctor names stay intact. Consultation periods and titles frequently split across lines, making the schedule harder to scan. | another layout was rated acceptable: Doctor names stay intact and titles have a little more room than in B, but consultation periods break across lines. The narrow specialty column still produces very tall rows. | another layout was rated poor: The specialty descriptions read much more comfortably, but the other columns are squeezed so tightly that headers, names, titles, departments and consultation times stack character by character. This makes the schedule difficult to scan.

log.raw: {"understanding":{"purpose":"帮助患者按科室查找医生，比较职称、出诊时段和擅长领域。","reading":"先定位合并的科室，再逐行查看医生及其出诊时间，并根据擅长领域选择；同一科室的合并单元格可利用多位医生的行高容纳换行。","groups":["科室、医生和职称共同标识医生及其专业背景。","出诊时间和擅长领域分别支持就诊安排与医生选择，需要逐行对应。"],"keep_intact":["医生姓名","单个出诊时段，如“周一上午”","职称尽可能按完整词组显示"],"may_wrap":["科室名称可在汉字之间换行，合并单元格的高度可吸收换行。","多个出诊时段可在标点处换行。","擅长领域是长篇中文描述，可自然换行。","较长职称在空间不足时可换行。"]},"designs":[{"name":"A","widths":[53,67,53,100,86],"idea":"优先保证医生姓名和单个出诊时段完整，方便快速比较排班，科室和职称换行，擅长领域较窄。"},{"name":"B","widths":[53,67,69,73,97],"idea":"增加职称和擅长领域的阅读空间，兼顾医生身份与专业描述，但出诊时段会拆行。"},{"name":"C","widths":[53,67,53,73,113],"idea":"把更多宽度留给长篇擅长领域，减轻描述的换行负担，同时保持姓名完整，接受职称和出诊时段较多换行。"}]}
